question: At p = 1009, 1511, and 1823, is the complete Joux-Vitse route from a non-weak challenge curve below corrected-hash, strongest-available, equal-advice Pollard rho in bitop/v1 and throughout the 0/0.1/1 GAE native-work band?

claims.text: For each requested prime separately, the complete charged route including the isogeny walk, F4, linear algebra, and verification is below the corrected strong/equal-advice rho throughout the preregistered price band.
claims.if_supported: Report below_strong_rho only at primes whose controls pass and whose four CI upper bounds are below one.
claims.if_not_supported: Report above_strong_rho, unresolved, or withheld exactly as the frozen rule determines.

hypotheses.statement: On the special full-rational-2-torsion extension-field class, the implemented genus-3 cover route remains cheaper than generic rho after complete route accounting.
hypotheses.mechanism: Joux-Vitse/Diem index calculus exploits the weak cover class; rho cannot exploit additional automorphisms beyond negation on these challenge curves.

predictions.minimum_effect: Every native and price-band 95% upper bound is below 1 at a supported prime.

data_seen.measured: Historical full-route seeds 1..4 at p=1009 and 1511

arms.description: Complete challenge-to-weak-class Joux-Vitse route, including charged walk, transport, cover, sieve, descent/F4, linear algebra, and scalar verification.
Corrected-hash strong rho on the identical challenge curve: negation, cycle handling, batch-16 inversion, run index 0, no retained attack-specific advice.
Same strong-rho arm and instances with independent run index 1 for the null A/A comparison.
Unfolded, unbatched rho on the identical challenge for the theory-anchored positive control.
Exact separate-process repeat of IC seed 33 at each prime.

positive.expected_detection: At every prime, R0 mean steps/sqrt(l) is in [0.90,1.70] and R3 mean steps/sqrt(l) is in [0.55,1.30].

negative.not_applicable_reason: No synthetic negative population is meaningful for an algorithm-cost comparison; the prospectively bounded R3 A/A comparison is the null control.

factors.name: algorithm
factors.how: Every algorithm receives the same challenge tuple at every prime/seed.

factors.name: rho_run_index
factors.how: Run 0 is the reference and run 1 is frozen as A/A before data.

factors.name: process_repeat
factors.how: IC seed 33 is repeated in a separate process for the exact A/A check.

factors.name: native_price_weight_gae
factors.how: Every recorded row is repriced at all three frozen weights.

factors.name: wall_time
factors.how: Concurrent scheduling is not controlled tightly enough for a clock claim.

comparisons.reason: Same public challenge, target, source binary, primitive unit, and retained advice; only the algorithm differs.
comparisons.threshold: All four paired-bootstrap upper bounds below 1.

comparisons.reason: Independent rho randomness on identical instances.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Fixed IC,R3-0,R0,R3-1 order per seed; four one-thread attempts run concurrently and wall time is not a claim.

seed_derivation.note: Disjoint from historical seeds 1..32 and fixed before the study.

instance_sampling.rule: Exactly the three requested primes crossed with seeds 33..40; no replacement after a failure.

blinding.how: The deterministic public algorithms and expected order-of-magnitude gap make masking uninformative; all rules and code are frozen prospectively.

power.note: Eight paired instances per prime are not powered for a narrow equivalence claim, but pre-existing full-route evidence places the ratio orders of magnitude below one; the study is powered only to discriminate that preregistered threshold, and otherwise reports unresolved.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Historical p=1009/1511 full-route runs on a shared four-core host; p=1823 extrapolated by subgroup size.

primary.name: complete-route IC over strong rho
primary.definition: At each prime, ratio of mean counted attack bitops from the first charged attack operation through scalar verification; instance construction and wall time excluded.
primary.formula: mean(IC bitops)/mean(R3 run0 bitops), paired bootstrap by seed

primary.name: native-work price band
primary.definition: Same paired ratio after both arms' word/hash work is repriced at 0, 0.1, and 1 GAE per operation.

secondary.name: per-phase primitive totals
secondary.definition: Actual walk, transport, model, factor-base, relations, descent/F4, linear-algebra, verification, and rho primitive counts.

secondary.name: diagnostic wall time
secondary.definition: Concurrent-run elapsed time, recorded for operations only and never used for a verdict.

counters: bitop/v1 field_*, modr_*, word_op, hash_probe, rng_words by phase
attempt exit status and raw artifact SHA-256

execution.queue: GitHub Actions jv-isogeny-walk workflow: three explicit ubuntu-latest prerequisite gates, then crypto-eks-highmem requested-prime and validation panels

stopping_rules.rule: Execute exactly the 33 preregistered attempts per prime and never replace a scientific failure.
A missing, malformed, incorrect, capped, or failed attempt withholds that prime; partial artifacts remain in the attempt census.

decision_rule.text: At each prime, below_strong_rho requires every control and attempt to pass and the upper 95% bound to be below one for native bitop/v1 and all three GAE weights. Above requires all four lower bounds above one. Otherwise report unresolved; any failed/missing control or attempt is withheld.
decision_rule.threshold: 1.0 for each of four IC/R3 intervals, plus the frozen control windows
decision_rule.statistic: Paired ratio of means by seed with 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap CI95.
decision_rule.interval: Paired percentile bootstrap CI95, fixed deterministic seeds derived from 20261101 and prime/metric tags.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: IC/R3 counted-work ratio at native bitop/v1 and each GAE weight.

invalidation_rules: Any change to primes, seeds, moves, arms, corrected-hash identities, operation accounting, control windows, bootstrap, or decision thresholds after a study datum invalidates the prospective claim.
A missing or failed attempt cannot be dropped or replaced; it withholds the prime.
A foreign hook, unclassified attack modulus, unattributed attack bitop, missing charged walk, or absent descent/linear-algebra addition/multiplication invalidates the row.
Leaderboard promotion requires a complete validation-gate/v1 record with independent replay and recomputation.
inadmissible: Generalising this special-class result to random, prime-order, or standardised curves.
Using diagnostic wall time as a headline metric.
Dropping failures, changing seeds, or moving a tolerance after launch.
Omitting the attack's isogeny walk, F4 additions, linear-algebra operations, corrected rho hashes, or scalar verification.
Calling producer output validated before independent replay and recomputation pass.

extensions.ic_aa_replicate: seed 33 repeated once in a separate process
extensions.symmetry_diagnostic: jv_endo_check over seeds 33..40; every j must be in neither F_(p^2) nor F_(p^3)

amendments.reason: Version 1 run 41345698056 exhausted its 90-minute prerequisite-job budget after the first p=101 test passed and while the separate counted p=101 test was still running. No p=1009, p=1511, or p=1823 panel began, the run emitted no artifacts, and the retained attempt is infrastructure_incomplete rather than a scientific failure.
changes: Preserve the exact frozen version 1 bytes and a receipt for run 41345698056; report version 1 and version 2 together.
Run the recovery p=101 test, counted p=101 test, and corrected-rho/tools gate as three parallel fresh prerequisite jobs on explicit ubuntu-latest runners.
Budget 180 minutes independently for each p=101 job and 120 minutes for the corrected-rho/tools job; the requested-prime panel budget remains 21600 seconds.
Require all three version 2 prerequisite jobs to succeed before any requested-prime panel starts, and do not reuse the passing version 1 test.
Leave every scientific arm, prime, seed, metric, producer, analysis, tolerance, stopping rule, decision rule, and validation requirement unchanged.

amendments.reason: This amendment is explicitly gate-result-informed. Version 2 run 41353962971 exposed a contradictory prerequisite predicate after completing the counted p=101 route: LinearAlgebra was required to contain F_p field work even though the frozen counter specification assigns its Wiedemann and Berlekamp-Massey operations to modr_* at subgroup modulus l. Both other version 2 gates passed, but no requested-prime panel began, all 99 target attempts remained unstarted, and the run emitted no artifacts. The correction is filed after the version 2 gate failure and before every version 3 gate or panel datum.
changes: Preserve the exact frozen version 2 protocol, complete run log, failure receipt, and independent static audit; report versions 1, 2, and 3 together.
Change only the ignored counted p=101 prerequisite predicate: retain field-work requirements for field phases, add Transport, and remove LinearAlgebra from that field-only loop.
Require LinearAlgebra to contain nonzero ModrAdd, ModrMul, ModrInv, and WordOp; retain route correctness, two-run determinism, relation WordOp/HashProbe, descent FieldInv, and total IC work checks.
Require zero foreign-thread work, zero operations at an unclassified attack modulus, and zero unattributed attack work, matching the already frozen invalidation rules.
Run all three version 3 prerequisite jobs fresh and in parallel at the exact version 3 frozen commit; do not reuse either green version 2 prerequisite.
Leave every production path, scientific arm, prime, seed, metric, producer, analysis, price, tolerance, stopping rule, decision rule, panel budget, and independent validation requirement unchanged.
